metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: YUJMEZ crystallizes in the orthorhombic crystal system with space group C m c a. Reported CIF formula moiety: C264 H294 Gd2 Ni28 O88 S24 2-,2(C1 H3 O2 1+). From the CIF bond table, Gd1 (Gd) has 10 O neighbors; Ni1 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni2 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni3 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni4 (Ni) has 7 O neighbors; Ni5 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni6 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni7 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni4A (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Gd2 (Gd) has 10 O neighbors; Ni9 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni10 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni11 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni12 (Ni) has 7 O neighbors; Ni13 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni14 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni15 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni16 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni17 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni18 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni19 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni20 (Ni) has 7 O neighbors; Ni21 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni22 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni23 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni24 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni25 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni26 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni27 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni28 (Ni) has 7 O neighbors; Ni29 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni30 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni31 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni32 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 92 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 0.471-4.351 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 7.00-131.61°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula Gd2Ni28C266S24O100H298.
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
